title: Sextant
description: Fleet control plane for NixOS devices. Helm validates values against this schema on install and upgrade, so nothing here is marked required: a field that is required in practice but has a working default would turn an ordinary upgrade into a refusal. Types and choices are enforced; completeness is the wizard's job.

orgName.title: Organisation name
orgName.description: Shown in the console. One deployment serves one organisation.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Empty tracks the chart's appVersion, which is what you want unless you are pinning deliberately.

replicaCount.title: Console replicas
replicaCount.description: More than one needs persistence off: the volume is ReadWriteOnce and the chart refuses the combination.

secretName.title: Secret with SEXTANT_* keys
secretName.description: Name of an existing Secret in this namespace. It carries the sealing key and the database credentials; the chart never creates it, so the secret is not in anybody's git history.

write.title: Allow configuration writes
write.description: Off makes the console read-only, which is a real mode: a demo or a second replica that only shows state.

gateMode.title: Validation gate
gateMode.description: remote delegates every write to the gate-runner and is the only fail-closed option. eval needs nix in the console image, which the release image does not ship. none commits without validating and the chart refuses it unless allowUnvalidated is set.

allowUnvalidated.title: Acknowledge unvalidated writes
allowUnvalidated.description: Required to render gateMode: none together with write. Deliberately awkward.

engine.title: Network policy engine
engine.description: cilium ships CiliumNetworkPolicy, which is an unknown kind on any other CNI and fails the install there. kubernetes ships the same intent as plain NetworkPolicy. none leaves egress to the platform.

className.title: Ingress class
className.description: cilium, nginx, traefik: whatever this cluster runs.

oidc.title: Single sign-on
oidc.description: One SSO authority per deployment (ADR 0015). The console has no password login of its own, by design.

groupsClaim.description: The ID-token claim that carries groups. Empty is groups.

gitRemote.title: Fleet overlay repository
gitRemote.description: The git repository this console writes configuration to. Devices follow branches in it, so it is the fleet's source of truth rather than a backup target.

netrcSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the push credential.

enabled.description: Renders a CloudNativePG Cluster, so the CNPG operator has to be on the cluster.

storage.title: Database volume size
storage.description: WAL lives here. With archiving broken a small volume fills in hours, so this is not the place to be frugal.

acknowledgeSmallVolume.description: Render a volume under the 8Gi floor with backups enabled. A deliberate small cell says so here rather than discovering the fuse the way production did on 2026-08-13.

backup.description: Off-cluster backup. The chart renders the object store and a scheduled backup together or neither: WAL archiving with no base backup cannot restore.

schedule.description: Six fields, seconds first. CNPG cron is not five-field cron.

accessKeyIdKey.description: Key in the backup secret that holds the access key id.

secretAccessKeyKey.description: Key in the backup secret that holds the secret access key.

gateRunner.title: Gate runner
gateRunner.description: Evaluates every candidate configuration with nix before it reaches git. Wants real memory and a volume; it is the safety property this product sells.

requireAuth.description: Require a credential for the release cache. Roll the netrc out to every device first.

sizeLimit.description: Cap for the ephemeral cache volume, such as 20Gi.

hostVariants.description: Comma-separated suffixes the generator emits per host, such as ",-sb".

chunkSize.description: Host toplevels per nix process in the eval gate. Empty is the binary's default.

evalWorkers.description: Concurrent eval batches. Peak memory multiplies by it. Empty is 1.

gcInitialHeapSize.description: Boehm's initial heap in bytes, as GC_INITIAL_HEAP_SIZE. Empty leaves it to the collector.

evalJobs.description: The nix-eval-jobs binary, such as nix-eval-jobs. Empty uses the in-process chunker.

evalJobsMaxMemoryMB.description: Per-worker memory ceiling for nix-eval-jobs, in MB.

releaseChunkSize.description: Host toplevels per nix process on the release build. Empty builds in one invocation.

dataSize.description: Volume for the overlay clone, such as 2Gi.

resources.description: The gate-runner's requests and limits. Size them to evalWorkers and the eval ceilings.

mode.title: Database mode
mode.description: cnpg needs the CloudNativePG operator. embedded runs one Postgres in the release namespace, with no replication and no backup. none switches the observed plane off. Empty means cnpg when cnpg.enabled, none otherwise.

ephemeral.description: Keep the embedded database on an emptyDir instead of a volume. It is then gone with the pod.

resources.description: The embedded database's requests and limits.

kind.description: ingress, httproute (Gateway API, TLS on the Gateway) or none. Empty means ingress when ingress.enabled, none otherwise.

imagePullSecrets.title: Image pull secrets
imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for a private registry, as Kubernetes takes them: a list of {name}.

logFormat.description: How the console and the gate-runner write their log.
logFormat.title: Log format

viewerGroups.description: Comma-separated groups from the identity provider that get the viewer role on the whole organisation.
viewerGroups.title: Viewer groups

editorGroups.description: Comma-separated groups from the identity provider that get the editor role on the whole organisation.
editorGroups.title: Editor groups

ownerGroups.description: Comma-separated groups from the identity provider that get the owner role on the whole organisation.
ownerGroups.title: Owner groups

releaseCache.description: Build each ring's release before it is promoted and serve it from the gate-runner's signed cache. Needs gateRunner.cache.keySecret.
releaseCache.title: Release cache

defaultLocale.description: The console's language for whoever has not chosen one. Empty is English.
defaultLocale.title: Default language

defaultTimezone.description: An IANA time zone such as Europe/Amsterdam, for whoever has not chosen one. Empty is UTC.
defaultTimezone.title: Default time zone

upstreamRepo.description: The core image repository the upstream watcher polls for new releases. Empty turns the watcher off.

publicUrl.description: The address people reach the console on, such as https://console.example.org. The OIDC redirect URL is derived from it, and an https address turns on secure cookies.
publicUrl.title: Public address

ldap.title: Directory browse
ldap.description: Optional: group pickers read from an LDAP directory. Empty url leaves it off. The bind password goes in the secret as SEXTANT_LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD.

caSecret.description: A Secret holding ca.crt, for an ldaps:// directory whose certificate a private CA signs.

resources.description: The console container's requests and limits, as Kubernetes takes them.

devAuth.title: Passwordless demo
devAuth.description: Every request becomes an owner session and the console listens on loopback only, reached with kubectl port-forward. For a demo instance with invented devices, never for a real fleet.

simulator.title: Simulated fleet
simulator.description: fleetsim against this release's own console, for a demo instance. Keep off anywhere real devices report.

interval.description: How often each simulated device checks in, such as 30s.

sidecar.description: Run inside the console pod; required with devAuth.

station.description: A simulated imaging station on the same fleet. A tag turns it on.

failPercent.description: Share of jobs that fail once.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: separatePort keeps /metrics off the listener the ingress publishes; it discloses the build and the route inventory.
